verdicts.photo_observation: The DC-earthing/LA cable route (green/orange lines per the page-4 legend) is comprehensively and continuously traced from the rooftop LA marker down through the parapet, across the terrace, through building pillars floor-by-floor, and to the ground-level DC Earth Pit, AC Earth Pit, and LA Pit (pages 10-16), with visible PVC conduit at several points (notably page 14's rooftop pipe run).
